snippet.title: Terra Invicta - 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Grand Strategy Game
snippet.description:
An alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions, each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth’s nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.

Terra Invicta is set to release into 1.0 on January 5th, 2026, on Steam, GOG, Epic, and Microsoft Game Store!

➤ STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1176470/Terra_Invicta/
➤ GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/terra_invicta
➤ EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/terra-invicta-5bbf09
➤ Microsoft Game Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/terra-invicta-game-preview/9PB0GLGXQZ83
